description: Agent permissions for the Phase 3 low-voltage dry bench. The agent may observe, record, run approved procedures and force safe on its own. Clearing a trip and powering down need a human. Energising the permit output is decided by the deterministic kernel. Bypassing interlocks or limits is never possible.

force_safe.note: Always available: moving to safe can never make things worse.

reset_trip.note: A human confirms the cause of the trip is understood.

request_permit.note: ProcessGuardrail decides; reset must precede permit.

run_procedure.note: Only approved procedures; the runtime may still refuse on preconditions.

ack_operator_step.note: Only a human can confirm a physical action was performed.

draft_procedure.note: Drafts are inert until an engineer approves them.

start_interview.note: Opens the fact list. Ask in your own words; never arms the relay.

answer_interview.note: Record whatever you learned. Partial is fine.
